item.title: Organize Fonts
item.description: Now that I am building a lot of fonts on my computer, does anyone have a great idea how to organize them for easy access when designing? Rather than looking at the sample text in the design programs? I started my own typographic display–but it doesn’t stay alphabetical as I keep adding new fonts….and it has become pages long, and time consuming to create.
